note: Manitowoc County Expo (county fairgrounds) at 4921 Expo Drive, beside I-43. Three camping areas: Midway (asphalt pads), North (gravel pads, not to be used after heavy rain) and Vista Road (grass). No campfires or generators. During the August county fair, camping is limited to fair attendees at event rates. --Claude
